name: watchdog_warn
description: Emit one actionable main-session watchdog warning. Set importance explicitly: low or medium for user-only visibility, high only when the parent model must receive the finding. Do not use for nits, praise, informational notes, or clean reviews.

severity.description: concern for actionable risk, blocker for a likely wrong or unsafe outcome

importance.description: low or medium for user-only visibility; high when the parent model must receive the finding

summary.description: One concise sentence naming the issue.

evidence.description: Specific evidence from the turn delta or inspected files.

recommendedAction.description: Specific action the parent should take before accepting or continuing.

category.description: Category of the actionable warning; defaults to other when omitted.
